title: The Clever answer to the puzzle
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：clever　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 clever 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the farmer wrote of ① a clever answer to the puzzle in the almanac, and everybody in the field said at once that it was ② cleverrer than the one named there the year before. Three autumns on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the farmer, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the clever ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the cleverrest answer to the puzzle anybody in the field had ever seen, or so the almanac for September 1943 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too clever to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the clever ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a clever trick with the lock, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as clever as the trick with the lock they had once had in the old field. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was clever or not, and he said so.

By 1956 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the almanac. What the line asked for was ⑦ something clever, and nothing besides. The child from the next field called the whole plan ⑧ quite clever; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the almanac kept the names of the clever ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1959, year after year, she wrote of another clever answer to the puzzle in the same almanac, and the work, which took two autumns, seemed ⑨ cleverrer than anybody had expected. ⑩ The cleverrest trick with the lock in the whole field, she said in 1961, was the one she could never quite name; the clever ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 聪明（前置定语 a clever answer to the puzzle：1949 年农人在农事历里记下的那件聪明的答案）
B. adj. 聪明／精巧（比较级 cleverrer than：文中两处，一处比谜题的答案，一处比预想）
C. adj. 聪明／精巧（最高级 the cleverrest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 聪明（表语 too clever to do：母亲觉得它太聪明，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 精巧（前置定语 a clever trick with the lock：叔叔把整件事称作一桩精巧的巧招）
F. adj. 精巧（同级比较 as clever as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩开锁的巧招相比）
G. adj. 精巧（后置定语 something clever：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 精巧（受程度副词修饰 quite clever：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a clever answer to the puzzle
the cleverrest answer to the puzzle anybody
a clever trick with the lock
The cleverrest trick with the lock in

answers.why: clever 意为“聪明”，1949 年农人在农事历里记下的是“一件聪明的答案”，此处作前置定语 a clever answer to the puzzle。
clever 意为“聪明”，此处用比较级 cleverrer than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
clever 意为“聪明”，农事历上 九月 那行字说它是田垄里最聪明的一件，故用最高级 the cleverrest answer to the puzzle。
clever 意为“聪明”，母亲认为这件东西“太聪明了，谁也用不上”，too clever to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
clever 意为“精巧”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩精巧的巧招”，此处作前置定语 a clever trick with the lock。
clever 意为“精巧”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩开锁的巧招一样精巧”，同级比较用 as clever as。
clever 意为“精巧”，农事历上那半行字要的是“精巧的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something clever。
clever 意为“精巧”，邻田垄来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当精巧”，quite 修饰原级 clever。
clever 意为“精巧”，1959 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要精巧”，故用比较级 cleverrer than。
clever 意为“精巧”，母亲 1961 年说的是“整个田垄里最精巧的那一桩”，故用最高级 the cleverrest trick with the lock。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年，农人在农事历里记下了一件聪明的答案。（a clever answer to the puzzle）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更聪明。（cleverrer than …）
母亲觉得它太聪明，谁也用不上。（too clever to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩精巧的巧招。（a clever trick with the lock）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩开锁的巧招一样精巧。（as clever as …）
到了 1956 年，农事历上只剩半行字：要的是一件精巧的东西。（something clever）
answers: In 1949 the farmer wrote of a clever answer to the puzzle in the almanac.
Everybody said it was cleverrer than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too clever to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a clever trick with the lock.
He said nobody would call it as clever as the trick with the lock they had once had.
By 1956 the almanac asked for nothing but something clever.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 clever 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the farmer wrote of a clever answer to the puzzle in the almanac, and nobody forgot it.
It was the cleverrest answer to the puzzle in the field, or so the almanac says.
My mother thought it too clever to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a clever trick with the lock, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next field called the plan quite clever, and everybody laughed.
